en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 21.5.
Cūḷantaraduka, Kusalattika (The Lesser Intermediate Dyads, Wholesome Triads)

Conditioned by a state that is neither non-condition nor unwholesome, a state that is with condition and wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither non-condition nor unwholesome, a state that is with condition and unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a conditionless indeterminate state, a conditioned indeterminate state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One for root; one for predominance … pe … one for non-disappearance.
Not-unconditioned … pe … (Similar to the Conditioned-Duo.
Dependent on a non-visible and unwholesome state, a non-visible wholesome state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One for root … pe … one for non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a non-visible, unwholesome state, a non-visible unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] in the case of roots ... pe ... one in the case of non-disappearance.

In dependence on a non-visible, indeterminate state, a visible indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. In dependence on a non-visible, indeterminate state, a non-visible indeterminate state [arises].

[They] arise with root condition. Dependent on a non-visible and non-indeterminate state, both visible indeterminate and invisible indeterminate states arise with root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root;
three for predominance …pe… three for non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a non-reactive unwholesome state, a non-reactive wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] in the case of root; ... pe ... one in the case of non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a non-reactive non-unwholesome state, a non-reactive unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] in the case of root; ... pe ... one in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-reactive indeterminate state, a reactive indeterminate state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root there are three; under predominance there are three …pe… under non-disappearance there are three.
Conditioned by a non-form, non-wholesome state, a formless wholesome state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root there is one …pe… under non-disappearance there is one.
Conditioned by a non-form, non-unwholesome state, a formless unwholesome state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root there is one …pe… under non-disappearance there is one.

Dependent on a non-material and indeterminate state, a material and indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One under root; one under predominance …pe… one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither supramundane nor wholesome, a mundane wholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither supramundane nor wholesome, a supramundane wholesome state arises by way of root condition.
(Condensed. Under the root condition, two; ... up to ... under the non-disappearance condition, two.

Conditioned by a state that is neither supramundane nor unwholesome, a mundane unwholesome state arises by way of the root condition. (Condensed. Under the root condition, one; ... up to ... under the non-disappearance condition, one.
Dependent on a state that is neither mundane nor indeterminate, a mundane indeterminate state arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a supramundane or indeterminate state, a mundane indeterminate state arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Two under root, two under predominance … pe … two under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is not cognizable by any [consciousness] and is unwholesome, a state that is cognizable by some [consciousness] and is wholesome arises by way of root condition … three.

By way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). By way of root condition, conditioned by some state that is neither-discernible-nor-unwholesome, there arises some state that is unwholesome and neither-discernible.
(Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on some state that is neither-discernible-nor-indeterminate, there arises some state that is indeterminate and discernible by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; nine in the case of predominance; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
